sections.title: Going Rogue:  Place, Race, and Vagabonds since Shakespeare
sections.description: This course offers junior English majors the opportunity to design and undertake a semester-long research and writing project in an advanced seminar setting. Discussions will address research methods, advanced writing and critical thinking issues, Theory and Poetics, as well as debates within the Medieval and/or Renaissance period, with an added focus on difference and diaspora. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of current offerings.
